subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A lame excuse
solution:
The correct answer is **'Weak excuse".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's try to understand the given idiom with the help of an example:

__
 
• **A lame excuse - **An excuse or reasoning that is considered pathetically unconvincing or inadequate.

 
 
• ***Eg.*** When* I asked him why he was late,* he just gave me some lame excuse about his alarm clock not going off.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here let's see some related idioms:

 
• **Lame duck (idiom) - **Someone or something that needs help.

 
 
• ***Eg. ***The company started as a* lame duck* that was saved by an innovative entrepreneur who decided to take some risks and go in a new direction.
 
 
 
• **Lame joke *(idiom) *-** A joke that is deemed (often by the listener) to be corny or otherwise not amusing.
 
 
• ***Eg.*** My date clearly thinks he's hilarious, but all I heard was a bunch of* lame jokes.*
